title: Heat pump myths 🤯😱 DO NOT believe them!!
summary: A Colorado HVAC company rebuts heat pump myths in 2023: cold-weather performance, purchase cost, running cost (depends on local prices, solar helps), noise and heating-only.

assertions.quote: And so far, the coldest night I've experienced is -8° Fahrenheit.
heat pumps do not work well in cold weather. Now, this could not be further from the truth.
So often times it comes down to a wash depending on what is in your home currently.
it's true that a heat pump is more expensive than a standard air conditioner
natural gas prices and electricity prices vary widely across the country
some of our heat pump customers actually enjoyed a zero-dollar heating bill
high-efficiency heat pumps, are drastically quieter than most furnaces

verdicts.note: Inverter outdoor units are quiet at low speed, but comparing them with mostly indoor furnaces is not like-for-like.

assertions.quote: all a heat pump is is an air conditioner with a reversing valve
heat pumps only heat and that's actually not true at all
